+    cell_y = 227.18 / ROWS

+    light = cv2.cvtColor(target, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
+    sm = cv2.GaussianBlur(light, (0, 0), 13.0)

+    gy = cv2.Sobel(sm, cv2.CV_32F, 0, 1, ksize=3)
+    wells = s.wells()
+    palette_rgb = np.asarray([w["rgb"] for w in wells], np.float32)
+    palette_lab = cv2.cvtColor(palette_rgb.reshape(1, -1, 3), cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB).reshape(-1, 3)

+    # one gently curved sweep; palette color is selected from samples under its path.
